## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the ability to design comprehensive end-to-end tests for real-time features involving complex data flows, fault tolerance, and distributed system consistency.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time UI testing with latency constraints
- Service mocking for deterministic test outcomes
- Retry mechanisms with exponential backoff
- Idempotency in distributed write operations
- Eventual consistency across regional data stores
- Test isolation and cleanup strategies
